Hello Canada, I can't wait to meet you! ❤️
The Edmonton International Cat Festival is the only festival of its kind in Canada, bringing together cat lovers to celebrate cats and cat culture, while raising money and awareness for important cat rescue organizations! #YEGCatFest donates 100% of proceeds back to local rescue organizations. Since 2014, they’ve raised $39,000 for local rescues helping cats in need. The 2016 event takes place Saturday, May 28, and will feature even more CAT-ivities than before! We are not kitten you right meow. 
Get your ticket now at http://www.edmontoncatfest.com/buy-tickets-2016/
